target_customer: Blockchain developers, crypto startups and enterprises that need reliable node access and APIs without running their own infrastructure
problem: Running and scaling blockchain nodes is slow, costly and unreliable for application teams.
business_model: Usage based API and subscription plans for RPC endpoints and data tools

founders.name: Dmitry Shklovsky
founders.background_notes: Named in the 2021 seed announcement and on the YC page. No background found in opened sources.

founders.name: Alex Nabutovsky
founders.background_notes: Named in the seed announcement and quoted in the Series A release.

founders.name: Auston Bunsen
founders.background_notes: Named in the seed announcement and Series A release; not listed on the YC page.

founders.name: Manuel Kreutz
founders.background_notes: Named in the seed announcement and on the YC page.

competitors.name: Alchemy
competitors.what: Ethereum developer platform and node infrastructure, pitched as AWS for blockchains
competitors.traction_then: Claimed 70 percent of the most used Ethereum apps used it
competitors.funding_then: 80M USD Series B at about 505M valuation in April 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: Operating reliable multi region nodes across many chains is demanding infrastructure work, but built from standard cloud and open source clients.

defensibility.rationale: Developers integrate endpoints and tools, which creates mild lock in, but node access is commoditizing and Alchemy and Infura offered similar services.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent absorbed Quicknode. It raised 35M in 2021 and 60M in 2023 and added 75 chains by 2025.

market_need_then: The 2021 crypto and NFT boom drove developer demand; the Series A release cites over 2 billion requests per day, nearly 20,000 developers and about 20x revenue growth since March 2021.

branding.domain_note: Uses quicknode.com, the exact .com; no purchase history found.

identity.logo: Wordmark plus a standalone Q mark per the brand kit
identity.visual_style: Rebranded in November 2025 to unify products under one brand
identity.voice_and_tone: Build Without Compromise tagline; confident and developer focused

rebrands.why: Founders say it grew from an RPC service into a broader platform serving builders at every scale

brand_strength.rationale: A recognized developer infrastructure brand in crypto with a formal brand and press kit and a 2025 rebrand, but no mascot, merch or fan community found.

outcome_analysis: Quicknode joined YC in W21 just as the crypto cycle took off, raised a 5.3M seed in May 2021, a 35M Series A in October 2021 after claiming about 20x revenue growth, and a 60M Series B in January 2023 reported at an 800M valuation. It survived the downturn, expanded to over 75 chains and rebranded in 2025, though competition from Alchemy and Infura remains intense.
notes: The company website's safety check was rate limited, so it was not read. The seed date conflicts: the company blog says announced 2021-05-27 while the Series A release says March 2021. A 250M valuation for the Series A is reported in one search summary only and the 800M Series B valuation is stated as a valuation without a pre or post label, so post money is left null. Infura (ConsenSys) is named as a competitor only in undated profiles, so it is not listed. Founder education and prior employers were not found in opened sources. The YC page uses the slug quiknode in some listings.
